<thought>Use a concise, valid silicon CIF string (diamond structure) to enumerate all possible (1,1,1) surface slab terminations with default slab thickness and vacuum. The enumerate_slabs_text tool will return a JSON dictionary of slabs, which I will then write to a file named slabs.json and provide its path.</thought>
<action>enumerate_slabs_text</action>
<action_input>{
  "bulk_cif": "data_Si\\n_symmetry_space_group_name_H-M 'Fd-3m'\\n_cell_length_a 5.43\\n_cell_length_b 5.43\\n_cell_length_c 5.43\\n_cell_angle_alpha 90\\n_cell_angle_beta 90\\n_cell_angle_gamma 90\\n_symmetry_Int_Tables_number 227\\n_chemical_formula_sum 'Si'\\nloop_\\n_atom_site_label\\n_atom_site_type_symbol\\n_atom_site_fract_x\\n_atom_site_fract_y\\n_atom_site_fract_z\\nSi Si 0 0 0\\nSi Si 0.25 0.25 0.25"
}
